title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for Promoting High-Quality Economic Development
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Guarantees for Promoting High-Quality Economic Development

Fa Fa [2019] No. 26

To thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, earnestly study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discourses on high-quality economic development, implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee on promoting high-quality economic development, give full play to the trial functions of the people's courts, and provide high-level judicial services and guarantees for promoting high-quality economic development, the following opinions are formulated in light of the actual work of the people's courts.

I. Effectively strengthen the sense of responsibility and mission in serving high-quality economic development

At the present stage, the basic feature of China's economic development is the shift from a phase of high-speed growth to a phase of high-quality development. Promoting high-quality development is an inevitable requirement for maintaining sustained and healthy economic development, an inevitable requirement for adapting to changes in the principal contradiction in Chinese society and for building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and building a modern socialist country in all respects, an inevitable requirement for following the laws of economic development, and a fundamental requirement for the Party and the state to determine development ideas, formulate economic policies, and implement macroeconomic regulation for the current period and for the future. General Secretary Xi Jinping has repeatedly made important instructions and directives on adhering to the new development philosophy, promoting high-quality development, deepening supply-side structural reform, fighting the three critical battles, promoting all-round opening up, and promoting the development of the private economy, which have pointed the direction and provided fundamental guidance for the people's courts to serve high-quality economic development. People's courts at all levels must effectively strengthen their sense of responsibility and mission, adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discourses on high-quality economic development, strengthen the "Four Consciousnesses," firm the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds," fully implement the new development philosophy, adhere to the general work principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, adhere to serving the overall situation, justice for the people, and impartial justice, give full play to the functions of adjudication, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for sustained and healthy economic development and overall social stability.

II. Legally safeguard national security and social stability

Firmly establish a holistic view of national security, adhere to bottom-line thinking, enhance awareness of potential dangers, improve the ability to prevent and control risks, severely crack down on various infiltration, subversion, sabotage, violent terrorism, national separatism, and religious extremist crimes, lawfully punish all types of criminal offenses, and resolutely safeguard national political security, especially regime security and system security. Implement the policy of severe punishment according to law, unswervingly target the goal of eliminating organized crime and local mafia, keep a close eye on major cases involving organized crime and local mafia, keep a close eye on "networks of relationships" and "protective umbrellas," keep a close eye on the economic foundation of organized criminal forces, continue to exert efforts in severe punishment according to law, deepening strikes, uncovering behind-the-scenes elements, and comprehensive rectification, explore long-term mechanisms for source governance and systematic governance, and strive to strike deeply and thoroughly according to law, eliminating evil completely. Lawfully punish serious violent crimes such as homicide, robbery, kidnapping, and bombing, severely crack down on crimes that cause strong public reaction such as telecom and internet fraud, environmental pollution, and endangering food and drug safety, and effectively enhance the people's sense of security. Actively participate in social governance innovation, strengthen analysis and research on cases where civil disputes turn into criminal cases, actively provide judicial suggestions on risk prevention and control, and promote the construction of a social security prevention and control system.

III. Legally serve and guarantee supply-side structural reform

Seriously implement the requirements of the eight-character policy of "consolidate, strengthen, uplift, and smooth," and actively serve the deepening of supply-side structural reform. Lawfully and prudently hear bankruptcy cases, and promote the improvement of the system and mechanism for the rescue and exit of market entities. Adhere to the direction of marketization, rule of law, professionalization, and informatization in bankruptcy trials, protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties according to law, and promote the survival of the fittest among enterprises. Adhere to precise identification and classification-based measures, actively apply bankruptcy reorganization and bankruptcy conciliation procedures for enterprises that are in financial difficulties but still have development prospects and salvage value, promote the optimization and combination of production factors and the transformation and upgrading of enterprises, revitalize enterprises, and make market resource allocation more efficient. Explore the mechanism for differentiating between simple and complex bankruptcy cases, including eligible simple bankruptcy cases in the expedited trial process. Improve the centralized and unified jurisdiction system for bankruptcy cases, promptly and properly handle cases transferred from enforcement to bankruptcy, and achieve a benign working state of "able to enforce according to law, and if overall enforcement is impossible and meets the statutory conditions for bankruptcy, it should be bankrupted according to law." Promote the professional construction of bankruptcy trials, accelerate the construction of bankruptcy courts, enhance bankruptcy trial capabilities, and improve the quality and efficiency of bankruptcy case trials. Actively promote the improvement of the bankruptcy legal system and supporting mechanisms, promote personal bankruptcy legislation, promote the establishment of a bankruptcy administrator association, promote the establishment of a special fund for bankruptcy expenses, and promote the establishment of a normalized "government-court linkage" coordination mechanism. Lawfully and prudently hear cases involving advanced manufacturing and various new transaction modes, new business forms, and new business models, accurately grasp the standard of adjudication, promote the reduction of enterprise costs, and serve the conversion of old and new driving forces and the improvement of the industrial chain level.

IV. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights

Strengthen the protection of technological achievements in core technologies and cutting-edge fields such as the internet, big data, artificial intelligence, blockchain, operating systems, integrated circuits, and clean energy. Strengthen the protection of scientific and technological achievements with high innovation levels such as key generic technologies, cutting-edge leading technologies, modern engineering technologies, and disruptive technological innovations. Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights for key core technologies in the manufacturing sector. Through fair judgments, incentivize technological innovation, promote manufacturing enterprises to achieve industrial upgrading through technological progress and technological innovation, and encourage market entities to enhance their core competitiveness through innovation. Strengthen the protection of well-known brands, severely crack down on dishonest behaviors such as malicious trademark squatting, free-riding, and counterfeiting, and further purify the market competition environment. Lawfully stop unfair competition practices such as infringement of trade secrets, accelerate the improvement of the application of anti-monopoly law in the internet and digital economy fields, and create a fair, orderly, and vibrant market environment. Establish and improve the system of compensation for infringement damages that reflects the value of intellectual property, give full play to the role of punitive damages, and further increase the cost of intellectual property infringement. Deepen the reform of the "three-in-one" trial mechanism for intellectual property civil, administrative, and criminal cases, accurately grasp and implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity, correctly handle the relationship between intellectual property civil and criminal trials, and give full play to the deterrent effect of criminal trials in protecting intellectual property. Continuously optimize the layout of intellectual property litigation jurisdiction, improve evidence rules, and study the formulation of special procedural law for intellectual property litigation. Strengthen international judicial exchanges and cooperation in intellectual property protection, actively participate in building international intellectual property protection rules, promote the reform of the international intellectual property governance system, continuously improve the credibility, attractiveness, and influence of China's intellectual property protection, and strive to build China into a model of intellectual property protection and a preferred place for international intellectual property litigation.

V. Optimize the rule of law business environment

Deeply implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instruction that "the rule of law is the best business environment," continuously improve judicial quality, efficiency, and credibility, better play the role of the rule of law in consolidating foundations, stabilizing expectations, and benefiting the long term, and strive to create a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable law-based business environment. Strengthen the judicial protection of property rights, and effectively implement the requirements of comprehensive, lawful, and equal protection of property rights. Improve the normalized mechanism for identifying and correcting wrongful cases involving enterprises, and resolutely correct cases where the judgment is indeed erroneous according to law. Fully respect and protect autonomy of will, correctly handle the relationship between autonomy of will and administrative supervision, and provide strong judicial guarantees for the market to play a decisive role in resource allocation. Pay attention to the role of judicial judgments in regulating and guiding the behavior of market entities, promote all types of market entities to establish a sense of rules, and operate lawfully and in a standardized manner. Strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of shareholders, especially small and medium shareholders, and promote the standardization of corporate governance. Actively promote the construction of social integrity, protect honesty, trustworthiness, and fair competition according to law, and resolutely sanction dishonest and illegal acts.

VI. Legally and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of private enterprises and entrepreneurs

Lawfully punish illegal and criminal acts that infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of private enterprises and entrepreneurs, effectively enhance the personal and property security of entrepreneurs, and enable entrepreneurs to start businesses with peace of mind, invest with confidence, and operate with ease. Accurately grasp the boundary between crime and non-crime, strictly distinguish economic disputes from economic crimes, legal property from criminal proceeds, and legitimate financing from illegal fundraising, resolutely prevent the use of criminal means to intervene in economic disputes, resolutely prevent the treatment of economic disputes as crimes, and resolutely prevent the conversion of civil liability into criminal liability. Lawfully and strictly grasp the constitutive elements of the crime of illegal business operation and the crime of contract fraud, prevent arbitrary expansion of application, and properly resolve issues of overlapping civil and criminal cases. Lawfully and prudently apply compulsory measures, strictly prohibit the sealing, seizure, or freezing of涉案 property in violation of statutory authority and procedures, strictly prohibit obviously excessive or over-scope sealing or seizure, and strictly prohibit the illegal sealing or seizure of property of persons not involved in the case. Lawfully and fairly hear cases involving financial loans, financial leasing, private lending, etc., of private enterprises, properly handle disputes such as triangular debts, equity pledges, and inter-connected guarantees, and lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of private enterprises. Lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of private economic entities as administrative counterparts, ensure that all types of market entities equally use production factors and equally enjoy national support policies, and lawfully protect the autonomy of market entities in business operations.

VII. Legally protect consumer rights

Lawfully hear all types of cases involving consumer rights, actively respond to public concerns, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of consumers. Promptly formulate and improve relevant judicial interpretations concerning food and drug safety, tourism disputes, and consumer civil public interest litigation, unify adjudication standards, and ensure the correct implementation of the law. Promptly publicly release guiding cases on consumer rights protection, adhere to the concept of supporting lawful rights protection, advocating rational rights protection, and curbing improper rights protection. Accurately grasp the general trend of upgrading residents' consumption, actively adapt to changes in residents' demand for high-quality products and personalized services, and effectively improve the level of judicial guarantees. Strengthen research and judgment on new situations and problems in emerging consumption fields or modes such as courier services, online ride-hailing, credit card consumption, online shopping, online prepaid consumption, and cross-border online transactions, adhere to the judicial value orientation of unifying encouragement and regulation. Further strengthen communication and collaboration with administrative organs, industry organizations, and social organizations, promote the establishment and improvement of diversified dispute resolution mechanisms and online dispute resolution mechanisms, integrate dispute resolution resources, strengthen the connection between litigation and mediation, further reduce the cost of consumer rights protection, and effectively resolve conflicts and disputes. Actively carry out international cooperation in judicial protection of consumer rights, and explore the application of law and international cooperation mechanisms for consumer rights disputes in cross-border online transactions.

VIII. Legally serve and guarantee the three critical battles

Lawfully hear all types of financial cases, guide and regulate financial transactions, severely crack down on acts of obtaining financial funds for re-lending, prevent and curb the shift of financial capital from the real economy to the virtual economy, and effectively serve the real economy. Lawfully support financing innovation for eligible strategic emerging industries and manufacturing enterprises. Lawfully regulate usury and predatory lending, increase the identification and crackdown on illegal financial activities such as illegal absorption of public deposits, fund-raising fraud, and "routine loans" in areas such as P2P online lending, strengthen early warning and research and judgment, prevent the transmission of financial risks that may be triggered by specific types of cases, and effectively prevent and resolve systemic financial risks. Lawfully and prudently hear real estate dispute cases, and prevent the transmission and transformation of real estate market risks to financial risks. Lawfully punish crimes such as producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy pesticides, fertilizers, seeds, etc., that harm farmers' interests, and maintain agricultural production order and rural social stability. Lawfully and severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts such as embezzlement, misappropriation, and corruption of special funds for agricultural investment, grain subsidies, etc., and ensure the effective implementation of national agricultural policies. Lawfully and prudently hear cases involving rural land contracting, and deeply implement the reform policy of "separation of three rights" for contracted land. Lawfully and in accordance with regulations hear disputes concerning the "separation of three rights" for rural homesteads and the entry of collective operating construction land into the market, and safeguard the reform of the rural land system. Properly hear cases involving rural property rights protection, investment and financing rights, and agricultural scientific and technological innovation, maintain agricultural and rural production and operation order, and effectively protect farmers' rights. Precisely meet the judicial needs of the people in impoverished areas, and actively serve the fight against poverty. Give full play to the role of people's courts in rural governance, promote the improvement of a governance system combining self-governance, rule of law, and rule of virtue in rural areas, and serve and guarantee the implementation of the rural revitalization strategy. Lawfully hear criminal, civil, and administrative cases involving environmental pollution and ecological destruction, promote the full implementation of the environmental public interest litigation and ecological environment damage compensation litigation systems, and explore the improvement of trial rules for environmental resource cases involving the development and utilization of natural resources, new energy, and climate change. Lawfully support and supervise administrative law enforcement actions in environmental protection and natural resource management, strengthen the enforcement of non-litigation administrative cases such as environmental pollution administrative penalties and the collection of sewage charges, and effectively maintain the effectiveness and authority of administrative law enforcement.

IX. Legally serve the construction of an open economy

Strengthen the trial of foreign-related commercial and maritime cases, lawfully and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties, promote the formation of a law-based, internationalized, and convenient business environment and a fair, open, unified, and efficient market environment, and actively serve the all-round opening up of the new era. Focus on serving and guaranteeing the joint construction of the "Belt and Road," the construction of pilot free trade zones, the construction of free trade ports, the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the implementation of the maritime power strategy, improve relevant policies and mechanisms, strengthen the construction of internationalized and specialized dispute resolution mechanisms, promptly resolve conflicts and disputes, and actively provide judicial suggestions. Seriously implement the Foreign Investment Law, actively adapt to the pre-establishment national treatment plus negative list system for foreign investment, lawfully and properly handle various disputes arising in the process of gradually liberalizing foreign investment fields, promptly issue relevant judicial interpretations of the Foreign Investment Law, and lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of foreign investors. Promptly clean up judicial interpretations and normative documents that are inconsistent with the basic policies and principles of the state's opening up, promote the liberalization and facilitation of trade and investment, and promote the formation of a more open, fair, and convenient investment environment. Improve the construction of the international judicial assistance system and mechanism, and improve the professional level of handling international judicial assistance cases. Give full play to the role of the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court and the International Commercial Expert Committee, support regions with a high degree of openness in establishing more professional international commercial adjudication institutions, improve diversified resolution mechanisms for international commercial disputes, and provide high-quality and efficient judicial services. Deepen international judicial exchanges and cooperation, actively participate in the formulation of relevant international rules, give full play to the role of judicial functions, and contribute strength to maintaining the multilateral trading system and promoting the reform and improvement of the global economic governance system.

X. Strengthen judicial guarantee work for the people's livelihood

Adhere to the people-centered approach, properly hear cases involving education, medical care, old-age care, housing, environment, labor employment, social security, and other related fields, pay more attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of vulnerable groups, and promote the guarantee and improvement of the people's livelihood. Deepen the reform of the family trial method and working mechanism, promote the professional, social, and humanized resolution of family disputes, and explore the promotion of coordinated development of family trials and juvenile trials. Further improve and perfect the socialist juvenile justice system with Chinese characteristics, actively prevent juvenile delinquency, and strengthen judicial protection of the rights and interests of juveniles. Actively participate in the construction of a safe campus and strengthen the prevention and control of campus bullying. Promote pilot projects of linkage mechanisms between judicial protection and administrative, family, school, and community protection, and strengthen judicial protection of the legitimate rights and interests of left-behind elderly, left-behind children, etc. Lawfully and severely crack down on criminal acts of defrauding special groups using health products, investment and financial management, etc. Do a good job in state compensation and judicial assistance work, promote the organic connection between judicial assistance, legal aid, and social assistance, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of people with difficulties in life. Consolidate and deepen the achievements of "basically solving the problem of difficulty in enforcement," improve the long-term mechanism for solving enforcement difficulties, further improve the joint disciplinary mechanism for dishonesty, strengthen enforcement of cases involving people's livelihood, and effectively ensure that the prevailing parties realize their rights in a timely manner.

XI. Comprehensively improve the ability to resolve conflicts and disputes and serve the people

Adhere to the innovative development of the "Fengqiao experience" in the new era, actively integrate into the social governance pattern led by Party committees, insist on placing non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms at the forefront, give full play to the role of people's courts in participating, promoting, regulating, and guaranteeing social governance, and promote the prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes from the source. Coordinate the promotion of the construction of "two one-stop centers," improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism at the front end of litigation, organically link various dispute resolution forces, strengthen the substantive dispute resolution function of the litigation service center, build and utilize typed and specialized dispute resolution platforms, and provide the public with multiple channels, levels, and types of dispute resolution avenues. Comprehensively build a modern litigation service system that is intensive and efficient, diverse in dispute resolution, convenient and beneficial to the people, smart and precise, open and interactive, and integrated and shared, to better achieve one-stop diversified dispute resolution and one-stop litigation services. Strengthen the standardized construction of litigation service halls, litigation service networks, and the 12368 litigation service hotline, to facilitate litigants to "get it done at once" for various litigation service matters. Accelerate the promotion of smart litigation services, form a new model of "one-stop online" litigation services, and provide litigants with online inquiry, consultation, payment, service of process, mediation, court hearings, and other one-stop electronic litigation services. Accelerate the promotion of online case filing and cross-regional case filing services, to achieve the ability to file cases nearby, at multiple points, and quickly with less running around, maximizing convenience for the public to file lawsuits. Explore the centralization of trial-supportive and transactional work in the litigation service center, promote intensive management, improve the mechanism for purchasing social services, and provide the people with higher quality, more efficient, and more convenient litigation services.

XII. Establish and improve the working mechanism for serving and guaranteeing high-quality economic development

Establish a normalized supervision and evaluation mechanism, establish a work ledger for serving and guaranteeing high-quality development, clarify post responsibilities, quantify evaluation standards, strengthen supervision and inspection, and ensure work effectiveness. Strengthen research and guidance, promptly investigate and study the judicial needs and prominent issues in the process of promoting high-quality development, continuously summarize experiences and practices, and improve relevant policies and mechanisms. Higher-level courts should strengthen guidance on difficult, complex, and new types of cases, improve the guiding case system, and the work mechanism for compulsory retrieval and reporting of similar cases and new types of cases, to promote the unification of adjudication standards. Give full play to the role of big data research and judicial suggestions, extend trial functions according to law, actively serve the decision-making of Party committees and governments, promote relevant units to improve management and work, prevent and reduce social conflicts and disputes, and promote the modernization of social governance. Strengthen legal publicity, promptly release typical cases of serving and guaranteeing high-quality development, actively carry out activities such as "judges going into ten places," carry out customized and precise legal popularization, fully utilize new media and self-media to strengthen legal publicity, and create a good rule of law environment for promoting high-quality development.

October 24, 2019
